page.overview:
Who is Barbariccia?

Barbariccia is a voidsent who serves as a boss and antagonist in Final Fantasy XIV: Endwalker patch 6.2. Formerly an elezen living in the Thirteenth reflection of the Source before the Flood of Darkness twisted her into an aether-starved creature, Barbariccia served under Golbez as one of his archfiends.

The woman who would come to be known as "Barbariccia" was the sole daughter of a former criminal family that had recently risen to nobility. She was raised in isolation and with no agency, rarely leaving her family's manor and not being allowed to choose what to do. With the aid of one of her maids she secretly left the manor to enjoy a moment of freedom, but was found by her father who dragged her back to his manor and once more imprisoned her, this time locking doors and windows, not even allowing her to enjoy the breeze.

Having tasted freedom once she continued to look for a way out, finally managing to escape her home once more. Free at last, she hoped to meet with people she considered friends and arrived at their meeting place to wait for them. Some time later it was not her friends who she found, but her father, who claimed he'd killed them so as to not allow "miscreants" to cavort with his daughter. Once more he demanded of her to not speak her mind and exist only as a means for her family to gain influence, her father laid down his demands, threatening her if she deigned disobey him again. Enraged, the woman cursed her father and attacked him with a botanist's axe, murdering him.

Beaming with exhilaration at the chance to "speak her mind", the woman celebrated her newfound freedom and struck out into the world. In this time she discovered her true calling, that of a warrior on the battlefield. It was during this career that she took the name "Barbariccia", becoming famous for both her beauty and savagery..|name=Shadowed Pasts}}
